title: AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay
abstract: arXiv:2611.28202v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal foundation models can play video games well when the game waits for them, but often fail when it keeps running. We find that much of this gap lies in the harness, which decides what the model sees, what it remembers, and how its outputs become actions over time. Existing harnesses such as VISTA improve the first two, yet turn each model call into at most one action, so the agent acts only as often as its model thinks. We introduce AutoPILOT, which changes the third: in each model call, the model can send a primitive action, start an open-loop macro, or write a closed-loop controller that keeps playing from the screen without further model calls until it hands control back. To evaluate agents in real-time games, we build AFK-Bench, 120 diverse browser games grouped by how they respond to inaction and playable in real time or with the clock paused. With GPT-6.1 Sol under the same budgets, AutoPILOT reaches 68.6% real-time succes

translated_title: AutoPILOT：面向实时游戏玩法（Gameplay）的视觉智能体框架
translated_abstract: 多模态基础模型在游戏等待它们时能够很好地玩视频游戏，但当游戏持续运行时往往会失败。我们发现这一差距很大程度上源于框架（harness），它决定了模型看到什么、记住什么，以及其输出如何随时间转化为动作。现有的框架（如 VISTA）改进了前两个方面，但将每次模型调用最多转化为一个动作，因此智能体的行动频率仅与其模型的思考频率相同。我们提出了 AutoPILOT，它改变了第三个方面：在每次模型调用中，模型可以发送一个基本动作、启动一个开环宏，或者编写一个闭环控制器，该控制器可以从屏幕上持续进行游戏而无需进一步的模型调用，直到它交回控制权。为了在实时游戏中评估智能体，我们构建了 AFK-Bench，包含 120 个多样化的浏览器游戏，根据它们对无操作状态的响应方式进行分组，并支持实时游玩或时钟暂停模式游玩。在相同预算下使用 GPT-6.1 Sol，AutoPILOT 达到了 68.6% 的实时成功率。
tldr: AutoPILOT 突破了传统框架“一次模型调用只产生一个动作”的限制，允许模型在每次调用中发送基本动作、开环宏或编写可自主持续游戏的闭环控制器，显著提升了多模态智能体在实时游戏中的成功率。
en_tdlr: AutoPILOT breaks the "one model call, one action" limitation by letting the model emit primitive actions, start open-loop macros, or write closed-loop controllers that keep playing autonomously, dramatically improving multimodal agents' real-time gameplay success.
